module: Editor imgui utility class: a cascading vehicle selector Type > Model > Config, optionally with up to 3 paints (paintNameKeys paintName/paintName2/paintName3) and a custom config file (.pc). The module returns a constructor: `require('editor/util/vehicleSelectUtil')(name, data)`. Used for example by the imVehicleSelect flowgraph node, multiSpawnManager, trafficManager and the mission editor.
usage:
local sel = require('editor/util/vehicleSelectUtil')('Mon véhicule')
sel:setOptions({enablePaints = true, paintLayers = 2})
-- in an imgui callback:
local reason = sel:widget() -- 'type' | 'model' | 'config' | 'paintName' | 'customConfig' | nil
if reason then print(sel.model, sel.config, sel.configPath) end
notes: widget() returns the reason for the change (updateReason) or nil: 'type', 'model', 'config', 'paintName'/'paintName2'/'paintName3' (field key) or 'customConfig'.
Result read from the instance fields: model (key), config (key), configPath ('vehicles/<model>/<config>.pc' or custom path), paintName, paintName2, paintName3, vehType, customConfigActive.

Default allowed types: Car, Truck, Automation, Trailer, Prop, Utility, Traffic, Unknown, Any; if allowedTypes has only one element, the Type combo is disabled. Allowed config subtypes: PropTraffic, PropParked.
If only one model (or one config) is available, it is selected automatically and the combo is grayed out.
setModelListByField and setConfigListByField are empty stubs (marked TODO): they do nothing.
fetchData sets self.modelName = dumps(Name), so the name contains quotes as long as it comes from this path.
In the model loop, if a model has no Name, `label` is nil and the concatenation raises an error.

C.desc: Selector instance. Option fields: allowedTypes, allowedSubtypes, modelBlacklist (table key->true), configBlacklist (model -> {configKey = true}), enableConfigs (true), enablePaints (false), enableCustomConfig (false), paintLayers (3), columnWidth (80 by default, multiplied by im.uiscale).

init.desc: Constructor: creates a unique id, resets selections and options, then applies `data` if given.

name.desc: Displayed name of the instance ('Vehicle' by default).

data.desc: Initial selection: model, config, customConfigPath, customConfigActive, configPath, paintName(2,3).

setModel.desc: Directly sets the model by its key; fills vehType and modelName from core_vehicles.getModel, or sets model back to nil if unknown.

setConfig.desc: Directly sets the config by its key (the model must already be set); computes configName and configPath. Sets config back to nil if the config does not exist.

config.desc: Config key (name of the .pc without extension).

setOptions.desc: Copies the options enableConfigs, enablePaints, enableCustomConfig, paintLayers and columnWidth present (truthy) in data to the instance.

resetModel.desc: Clears the model list and the chosen model.

resetConfig.desc: Clears the configs, the chosen config and the custom config.

resetPaint.desc: Clears the available and chosen paints.

resetSelections.desc: Clears type, model, config and paints.

resetOptions.desc: Resets the options to default (allowed types, empty blacklists, enableConfigs true, enablePaints false, 3 paint layers).

setModelListByField.desc: Stub (TODO): should filter models by field/value; does nothing.

disallow.desc: true to blacklist instead of whitelist.

setConfigListByField.desc: Stub (TODO): should filter the configs of a model by field/value; does nothing.

disallow.desc: true to blacklist instead of whitelist.

getPaintPtr.desc: Converts a paint (table {r,g,b,a}, or table with baseColor as an array or as x/y/z/w) into a 4-component imgui float array; white by default.

returns.desc: Temporary float[4] array of the editor (editor.getTempFloatArray4_TableTable).

fetchData.desc: Loads if needed the lists of models (filtered by type and blacklist, sorted by name), configs (filtered by blacklist and subtypes) and paints of the current model.

widget.desc: Draws the interface (combos Type, Model, Config, Paint 1-3, custom config field) and applies the cascading resets.

returns.desc: Reason for the change: 'type', 'model', 'config', 'paintName', 'paintName2', 'paintName3', 'customConfig', or nil.
